sources.title: U.S. Treasury Financial Report for FY 2024 and GAO Schedule of Federal Debt Audit
sources.source_type: U.S. Treasury financial report and GAO federal debt audit
sources.date_label: Fiscal year 2024; debt balance as of September 30, 2024
sources.original_term: Federal debt; debt held by the public; intragovernmental debt
sources.original_text: GAO-25-107138 reports that total federal debt managed by the Bureau of the Fiscal Service was $35.460 trillion on September 30, 2024. During FY 2024, total debt increased by $2.298 trillion: debt held by the public increased by $1.977 trillion and intragovernmental holdings increased by $321 billion. The report states that the FY 2024 budget deficit was $1.833 trillion and identifies borrowing to finance annual deficits as the primary reason for the increase in debt held by the public.

sources.publisher: U.S. Government Accountability Office; U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
sources.reference_number: GAO-25-107138; FY 2024 Financial Report of the U.S. Government

sources.section: Schedules of Federal Debt; Government’s Financial Position and Condition
sources.source_identity: Official GAO financial audit of Fiscal Service’s FY2024 and FY2023 Schedules of Federal Debt, cross-checked against Treasury’s FY2024 Financial Report.
sources.historical_claim: At September 30, 2024, total federal debt managed by Fiscal Service was $35.460 trillion. During FY2024, it rose $2.298 trillion, comprising a $1.977 trillion increase in debt held by the public and a $321 billion increase in intragovernmental holdings. GAO reports the FY2024 deficit as $1.833 trillion and identifies deficit-financing borrowing as the primary reason for the increase in debt held by the public.
sources.context: This is a fiscal-year measure, not a calendar-year debt-growth rate. Total federal debt includes debt held by the public and intragovernmental holdings; these categories must not be conflated. The increase in debt held by the public exceeded the reported deficit partly because of changes in the government’s cash balance, partly offset by federal direct-loan financing activity.
sources.interpretation: The audited schedule provides an institutional record of federal debt stocks and year-over-year changes, while Treasury’s financial report explains the distinction between publicly held debt and intragovernmental holdings.
sources.notes: GAO-25-107138 highlights page i and printed p. 25 Schedule of Federal Debt original PDF page images inspected. Total federal debt managed by Fiscal Service was $35,460 billion at September 30, 2024, versus $33,162 billion in FY2023. Principal debt held by the public was $28,307,312 million and intragovernmental principal holdings were $7,152,848 million. FY2024 principal public-held debt increased $1,977,170 million (borrowings $28,634,163 million less repayments $26,656,993 million); intragovernmental principal increased $321,149 million. GAO reports FY2024 deficit $1.833 trillion. Keep principal amounts separate from total debt balances including accrued interest and unamortized premiums/discounts.
sources.what_passage_establishes: The audited schedule reports the total federal debt managed by Fiscal Service and separates the FY2024 increase into debt held by the public and intragovernmental holdings. The accompanying explanation links the increase in publicly held debt primarily to borrowing for the annual budget deficit.
sources.evidence_limits: This evidence does not show that every dollar of new debt financed a particular expenditure, nor does it establish that the deficit was the only factor affecting debt balances. It is not a measure of all private or global debt.
sources.citation_record: U.S. Government Accountability Office, GAO-25-107138, Financial Audit: Bureau of the Fiscal Service’s FY 2024 and FY 2023 Schedules of Federal Debt (Nov. 7, 2024), accessible report, p. 2; U.S. Department of the Treasury, FY 2024 Financial Report of the U.S. Government, Management’s Discussion & Analysis.
scholarly_references: Primary institutional sources; no separate secondary scholarly reference asserted in this record.
sources.publication_status: Primary institutional evidence; official GAO highlights and detailed schedule page images checked; evidence grade B retained pending broader audit.

passage_record.status: Official GAO-25-107138 highlights and detailed Schedule of Federal Debt original PDF page images checked; numerical schedule reconciled.
passage_record.locator: GAO-25-107138, Highlights page (printed p. i) and Schedule of Federal Debt, printed p. 25; see also report overview, printed pp. 2–4.
passage_record.evidence: GAO reports $35.460 trillion total federal debt at September 30, 2024; FY2024 total debt increased $2.298 trillion, comprising a $1.977 trillion increase in debt held by the public and $321 billion in intragovernmental holdings. The FY2024 deficit was $1.833 trillion.
passage_record.significance: Links audited federal debt balances to the fiscal-year deficit while preserving the distinction between publicly held debt and intragovernmental holdings.
passage_record.verification_note: Original printed p. 25 schedule page image inspected. Principal public-held debt increase was $1,977,170 million and intragovernmental principal increase was $321,149 million. These principal movements are not interchangeable with the $2.298 trillion rounded total debt increase, because total balances also include accrued interest and net unamortized premiums/discounts. FY2024 deficit was $1.833 trillion.

sources.bn_title: মার্কিন ট্রেজারির ২০২৪ অর্থবছরের আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন ও GAO-র ফেডারেল ঋণ নিরীক্ষা
sources.bn_historical_claim: GAO-25-107138 অনুযায়ী, ২০২৪ সালের ৩০ সেপ্টেম্বর ফেডারেল ফিসকাল সার্ভিসের ব্যবস্থাপনাধীন মোট ফেডারেল ঋণ ছিল ৩৫.৪৬০ ট্রিলিয়ন ডলার। ২০২৪ অর্থবছরে মোট ঋণ ২.২৯৮ ট্রিলিয়ন ডলার বেড়েছিল: জনগণের হাতে থাকা ঋণ বেড়েছিল ১.৯৭৭ ট্রিলিয়ন ডলার এবং আন্তঃসরকারি ঋণধারণ বেড়েছিল ৩২১ বিলিয়ন ডলার। প্রতিবেদনে ২০২৪ অর্থবছরের ঘাটতি ১.৮৩৩ ট্রিলিয়ন ডলার বলা হয়েছে; জনগণের হাতে থাকা ঋণ বৃদ্ধির প্রধান কারণ হিসেবে বার্ষিক ঘাটতি মেটাতে ঋণগ্রহণকে চিহ্নিত করা হয়েছে।
sources.bn_context: এটি অর্থবছরভিত্তিক হিসাব, ক্যালেন্ডার বছরের ঋণবৃদ্ধির হার নয়। মোট ফেডারেল ঋণে জনগণের হাতে থাকা ঋণ ও আন্তঃসরকারি ঋণধারণ উভয়ই অন্তর্ভুক্ত।
sources.bn_interpretation: নিরীক্ষিত সূচি ফেডারেল ঋণের পরিমাণ ও বার্ষিক পরিবর্তনের প্রাতিষ্ঠানিক প্রমাণ দেয়। ট্রেজারির আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন জনগণের হাতে থাকা ঋণ ও আন্তঃসরকারি ঋণধারণের পার্থক্য ব্যাখ্যা করে।
sources.bn_notes: সংখ্যাগত বিভাজনের জন্য GAO-র প্রবেশযোগ্য প্রতিবেদন এবং সমর্থনকারী উৎস হিসেবে ট্রেজারির ২০২৪ অর্থবছরের আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন ব্যবহার করুন। মূল PDF পৃষ্ঠার ছবি এখনও পরীক্ষা করা হয়নি।
sources.bn_verification_status: GAO-র সরকারি নিরীক্ষা প্রতিবেদন ও ট্রেজারির ২০২৪ অর্থবছরের আর্থিক প্রতিবেদন মিলিয়ে মূল তথ্য পরীক্ষা করা হয়েছে; মূল PDF পৃষ্ঠার ছবি যাচাই বাকি।
